capabilities: Query quota and balance from AI coding providers
Display usage windows with percent used and reset countdown
Refresh cards individually or all at once
Export encrypted credentials to other devices
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later; quotas refresh only manually; several listed services have not been verified against real accounts; MIT licensed.
motivation: The author wanted the remaining quota of each AI coding plan aggregated in one Obsidian side panel instead of opening every official web console.
problem: Reviewing remaining quota across several AI coding subscriptions means opening each provider's web console separately.

relations.evidence: DeepSeek | API Key | Pay-as-you-go balance: top-up / bonus breakdown
Kimi For Coding | API Key | Shows the 5-hour and weekly windows
MiniMax | Subscription Key | 5-hour and weekly windows of the Token Plan subscription
Shows the official 5-hour / daily / weekly windows (varies by plan tier)

summary: Side panel that queries plan quota and balance from multiple AI coding services and accounts in one place.
